title: notSoSmartOCR
description: Built a document-intelligence product that turns complex scans into structured, reviewable outputs. It combines orientation correction, layout detection, Falcon OCR 1.5, and selective LLM refinement for handwriting and ambiguous regions, with page-level visual evidence, tables, and Markdown output.
image_alt: notSoSmartOCR interface with document examples, page evidence, and structured output panels during parsing

example.alt: OCR layout output identifying headings, text, author blocks, and bounding boxes on Attention Is All You Need
example.caption: Layout extraction example: detected text, headings, and table bounds on a research paper.

title: MycoGate-VL
description: Detects and categorizes hallucinated character spans in vision-language responses across English, French, Italian, and Chinese. Combines multilingual detectors, a learned clean-document gate, visual category supervision, and scorer-aware output serialization.
image_alt: MycoGate-VL example: the claimed count of eight lights is annotated as a hallucinated span with miscounting and invention labels

title: Position Bias in Mamba and Hybrid Language Models
venue: Accepted · New in ML at NeurIPS 2026
description: Mixing Matters studies how moving the same evidence through a long context changes retrieval across Transformer, Mamba, and hybrid models. The measured position-bias curves vary with the model, prompt, and task; the study does not isolate architecture as the cause.
image_alt: Line chart comparing position bias in Pythia, Mamba, and Mamba-2 models

title: RDAN-GRPO
description: Rubric Decoupled Advantage Normalisation GRPO is a rubric-based reinforcement learning repository for aligning LLMs with complex, open-domain instruction-following tasks. It improves performance on public instruction-following benchmarks.

title: Drishti
description: A scalable remote-sensing pipeline integrating EarthMind-4B, RemoteSAM, and a BERT classifier for unified satellite-image analysis. DRISHTI stands for Deep Remote-sensing Intelligence System for Holistic Task Integration. Awarded a silver medal at Inter IIT Tech Meet 14.0.

title: Tech-Enhanced AI Interview Learning Platform
description: Developed an interview practice platform that generates diverse, topic-specific questions and uses NLP to analyse spoken responses, identify grammatical errors, and provide corrections after the interview.
image_alt: Flowchart of the Tech-Enhanced AI Interview Learning Platform
